title: master data loom guardrails

excluded_rows.reason: The row requires one atomic transaction or RPC spanning shift_assignments, machine_assignments, and machines.current_order_id. A source-only partial change would not prove the no-mixed-context requirement, so it is excluded for a separate transactional database/RPC batch.

row_definitions_inspected.exact_row_wording: Bulk-add looms with duplicate names or types.
row_definitions_inspected.expected_behavior: Intended duplicate rule is enforced; no silent overwrite.
row_definitions_inspected.current_failure_evidence: The intended duplicate loom-name rule is not enforced in source/schema. addMachine, addMachinesBulk, and updateMachine do not check for an existing org-scoped name, and the machines table/migrations do not define UNIQUE(org_id, name). Duplicate names can therefore be silently accepted instead of blocked with a clear duplicate rule.

row_definitions_inspected.exact_row_wording: Deactivate/delete loom with active order or history.
row_definitions_inspected.expected_behavior: Protected action; history preserved; downstream UI remains consistent.
row_definitions_inspected.current_failure_evidence: Machine deletion protection is inconsistent. The supervisor path requires a one-time owner access code, but the owner Machines UI still performs a direct client-side Supabase delete after a browser confirm. The server delete helper also has no history preflight; production-log FKs may block deletion, while machine_assignments and shift_assignments are cascade-linked. This does not prove the guide's protected-action/history-preserved expectation end-to-end.

row_definitions_inspected.exact_row_wording: Two users edit same loom assignment.
row_definitions_inspected.expected_behavior: Last-write/concurrency behavior is visible and does not create mixed context.
row_definitions_inspected.current_failure_evidence: The assignment/concurrency path is not atomic. upsertShiftAssignment first writes the dated shift_assignments row, then separately upserts machine_assignments and updates machines.current_order_id; updateMachineAssignment is another independent mutation. There is a unique dated-assignment key, but no advisory lock or single transaction spanning the dated row, standing worker, and standing order. A failure or race between these writes can leave mixed context, contradicting the guide's no-mixed-context expectation.

inspection_report.migration_or_rpc_needed: Migration needed for true concurrent duplicate prevention. Created a forward-only unique index migration file but did not apply it.
inspection_report.future_qa_runtime_proof_required: Apply or otherwise validate the migration in QA after review, then prove duplicate manual add, duplicate bulk add, duplicate rename, normalized trim/case duplicate rejection, and same name in a different org allowed. Also prove normal different-name same-type looms remain allowed.

inspection_report.migration_or_rpc_needed: No migration/RPC created for this row. Source guard checks protected references before delete/deactivate.
inspection_report.future_qa_runtime_proof_required: Browser/API proof in QA that delete/deactivate is blocked for active production targets, active worker assignments, dated shift assignment history, and production history, with a clear message; prove unused loom delete/deactivate remains allowed if product behavior permits it.

inspection_report.migration_or_rpc_needed: Yes. Requires single transaction, RPC, or lock spanning dated assignment, standing assignment, and current loom target.
inspection_report.future_qa_runtime_proof_required: Separate batch should add transactional assignment update and race/rollback proof for two editors updating the same loom assignment.
